Nutrient composition
Avocados are known for their high fat
content; however, most is monounsaturated
fat.  They are low in saturated fat and are
sodium- and cholesterol-free.  Avocados are
a good source of dietary fiber.  They also
contain lutein, one of the carotenes that is a
phytochemical with antioxidant properties.
Family  Lauraceae
Scientific name Persea americana 
Common name avocado, alligator pear
♥Rich source of monounsaturated fat
♥Good source of fiber
The avocado is a pear-shaped fruit with skin that can be thick or thin, green 
or purplish black, and smooth or bumpy, depending 
on the variety.  The flesh of the avocado is pale 
yellow-green and has the consistency of firm 
butter and a faint nut-like flavor.
